title: XP: Epic Damage Indicator
description: It shows the damage within the game
body:
## Epic Damage Indicator It displays the damage dealt by the player as **floating-point numbers** above entities. This mod was originally created for the **XP: Attribute Core** mod and its critical hit system, but it also works perfectly with the vanilla version. Currently, there are **3 different visualization modes** available. These modes can be switched and customized through the configuration file, allowing players to choose the style that best fits their gameplay. *** ### This is how it looks in Stacked mode ![Stacked Mode Demo](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1713/832/stacked-gif.gif) *** ### This is how it looks in Popup mode ![Popup Mode Demo](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1713/840/popup-gif.gif) *** ### This is how it looks in Floating mode ![Floating Mode Demo](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1713/843/floating-gif.gif) ***
